title: A-727 automatic: kickdown and low-reverse band adjustment (1976-77 Dodge W/D trucks)
summary: Army procedure for adjusting both A-727 bands: torque the adjusting screw, back it off a set number of turns, and lock it.
tools: Inch-pound torque wrench with band adjusting adapter
warnings: From the Army manual for the M880 (military 1976-77 Dodge W200/D200). Confirm a civilian truck has the same part before using a number.

specs.name: Kickdown band screw, with adapter
specs.note: The scan reads "47 to SO in-lbs"; 50 is the evident reading. Check the printed page.

specs.name: Kickdown band screw, true torque (no adapter)

steps.text: Kickdown band: the adjusting screw is on the left side of the case near the throttle lever shaft. Loosen the locknut, back it off about five turns, and make sure the screw turns freely in the case.
Tighten the kickdown band adjusting screw to 47-50 in-lb with a torque wrench and adapter. On the bench without the adapter, use 72 in-lb (the true torque).
Back the kickdown screw off 2-1/2 turns, hold it there, and tighten the locknut to 35 ft-lb.
Low-reverse band: raise the vehicle, drain the fluid and remove the oil pan.
Loosen the low-reverse adjusting screw locknut, back it off about five turns, and check the screw turns freely in the lever.
Tighten the low-reverse adjusting screw to 72 in-lb with the torque wrench and adapter.
Back the screw off 2 turns, hold it there, and tighten the locknut to 30 ft-lb.
Reinstall the pan with a new gasket (pan bolts 150 in-lb) and fill with Dexron II type ATF.

sources.title: TM 9-2320-266-34: Direct and General Support Maintenance Manual, Truck, Cargo, 1-1/4 Ton, 4x4 (M880 series)
sources.publisher: Headquarters, Department of the Army, January 1976 (reprint with Changes 1-7)

author: Common Manual (AI-assisted)
